salesforce:update.salesforce:records: #[[{ Id: vars.sfId, Rocketlane_Id__c: payload.projectId as String }]]

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Project " ++ (vars.sfId default "?") ++ " synced to Rocketlane company " ++ ((vars.rlCompanyId default "?") as String)]

#[output text/plain --- "Rocketlane sync FAILED for Project " ++ (vars.sfId default "?") ++ ": " ++ (error.description default "") ++ " | Rocketlane response: " ++ write((error.childErrors[0].errorMessage.payload default error.errorMessage.payload) default "", "application/json") ++ " | Sent body: " ++ write(payload, "application/json")]

#[output text/plain --- "UPDATE detected for Project " ++ (payload.data.payload.ChangeEventHeader.recordIds joinBy ",") ++ " | changed: " ++ (payload.data.payload.ChangeEventHeader.changedFields joinBy ",")]
